description_en: Updates an existing approval process definition
description_zh: 用于更新已有的审批流程定义信息
name: UpdateProcessDefinition

parameters.help_en: The ID of the approval process definition
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The name of the approval process definition
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: lwt_ide_simple 项目 MaxCompute 表审批策略
parameters.help_en: The description of the approval process definition
parameters.name: description

fields.help_en: The conditional expression, such as `((#type=='typeValue'))` or `((#odpsProject=='PX_BEIJING_TEST'))`
fields.name: expression

fields.help_en:
The stage where the rule takes effect. Valid values:
Deployment: Used to determine whether the approval policy is matched when the application is submitted.
Running: Used to determine whether to skip approval while the approval process runs. [Supported only for MaxCompute]
fields.help_zh:
规则生效阶段：
Deployment 用于判定"提交申请时是否匹配该审批策略
Running 用于审批流程执行判定是否免审批【仅支持MaxCompute类型】
fields.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The list of conditional rules. Note: System policies do not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 条件规则列表。注意：系统策略不生效
parameters.name: rule_conditions

fields.help_en:
The notification channel. Valid values:

Mail
Sms
DingRobot
Weixin
fields.help_zh:
通知渠道，枚举

Mail
Sms
DingRobot
Weixin
fields.name: channel

fields.help_en: The extended information in JSON format. For example, `{"atAll":"true"}` specifies whether to mention all users
fields.help_zh: 扩展信息，JSON 格式，如 {"atAll":"true"} 声明是否@所有人
fields.name: extension

fields.help_en: The Webhook URL. This parameter is required when the channel is DingRobot or Weixin
fields.name: receiver

fields.help_en:
The type of approver for the node. Valid values:
DataWorksProjectRole: Workspace role
DataWorksProjectMember: Workspace member
TableAdministrator: Table owner
TableOrProjectAdministrator: Table or workspace administrator
AliyunResourceOwner: Alibaba Cloud account
MaxComputeRole: MaxCompute administrator
DLFAdmin: DLF legacy administrator
DLFNextAdmin: DLFNext administrator
TenantRole: Tenant role
EmrAdministrator: EMR administrator
LindormAdministrator: Lindorm administrator
AliyunRamUser: RAM user
fields.help_zh:
节点审批人类型：
DataWorksProjectRole 空间角色
DataWorksProjectMember 空间成员
TableAdministrator 表负责人
TableOrProjectAdministrator 表或空间管理员
AliyunResourceOwner 阿里云账号
MaxComputeRole MC管理员
DLFAdmin DlfLegacy管理员
DLFNextAdmin DLFNext管理员
TenantRole 租户角色
EmrAdministrator Emr管理员
LindormAdministrator Lindorm管理员
AliyunRamUser RAM子账号
fields.name: account_type

fields.help_en:
The assignees. The semantics vary based on the AccountType:
DataWorksProjectMember: Specifies the user ID of the workspace member.
DataWorksProjectRole: Specifies the code of the workspace role.
MaxComputeRole: Specifies the MaxCompute role.
TenantRole: Specifies the code of the tenant role.
AliyunRamUser: Specifies the RAM user ID
fields.help_zh:
当AccountType为不同类型，对应不同语义：
DataWorksProjectMember声明空间成员UserId
DataWorksProjectRole声明空间角色code
MaxComputeRole声明MC的角色
TenantRole声明租户角色code
AliyunRamUser声明RAM userId
fields.name: assignees

fields.help_en:
The extension properties. Different additional declarations are required based on the AccountType:

`DataWorksProjectMember`: The key is projectId, and the value is the user ID of the workspace member. Separate multiple values with commas.
`MaxComputeRole`: The key is the MaxCompute project, and the value is the role name in MaxCompute. Separate multiple values with commas
fields.help_zh:
当 `AccountType ` 为不同类型，需要提供不同额外声明：

`DataWorksProjectMember`: key 为 projectId, value 为空间成员 UserId，多个使用逗号分割
`MaxComputeRole`: key 为 MaxCompute 的 project, value 为 MC 中 role name，多个使用逗号分割
fields.name: extension_properties

parameters.help_en: The list of approval nodes. Note: System policies do not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 审批节点列表。注意：系统策略不生效
parameters.name: approval_nodes

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. Used to prevent duplicate operations caused by multiple calls
parameters.help_zh: 幂等参数。用于避免多次调用导致操作重复
parameters.name: client_token

schema.description_en: The error code in the API response. This field is not empty if an error occurs during the call
schema.description_zh: API 请求响应错误码，调用出错时非空

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the API request
